predecessor.reason: Preserves the initial role-gap assessment. Its conservative removal of Reader-to-Guest is superseded by this per-member proposal at Root's direction.

contract.primary: Exact public anyproto/any-sync tag v0.13.8 resolved to the immutable commit below; whole validator.go and models.go independently match the SHA256 and bytes reported by W1.
contract.authorityRule: AclPermissions.CanManageAccounts() is true only for Owner or Admin. ValidatePermissionChange rejects a Guest target or Owner target; only Owner may alter an Admin or grant Admin. Granting Guest is rejected unless the target's current role is Reader. That Guest-specific check imposes no additional Owner-only condition. Thus Owner and Admin may change a current Reader to Guest, subject to the unchanged shared active/non-self target restrictions.
contract.removal: ValidateAccountRemove has a distinct path: rejects self, missing/None, Owner, and Admin target unless actor is Owner, but does not reject a Guest target. Preserve Guest removal separately.
contract.approval: Reader/Writer remain ordinary request-approval roles; Admin is included only for Owner. No Owner transfer, Guest-key factory or unqualified Guest approval is added.

concreteMismatch.behavior: Current Owner global grantableRoles includes Guest for every target and approval; editableMemberIDs includes Guest targets. Shared memberRow and mutation.validate use the same global grant list.
concreteMismatch.currentlyMissingValidTransition: Current Admin global list lacks Guest, so Admin -> current Reader -> Guest is not offered, although the exact Native validator permits it.

sharedAPI.initializer: Append memberRoleOptions: [String: [PinkhaSharingRole]]? = nil as a trailing labeled initializer argument. Keep every existing argument and default caller behavior.
accessorSemantics: First require editableMemberIDs contains identity; otherwise return [].
If memberRoleOptions is nil, return the existing grantableRoles list.
If a map is supplied, return only map[identity] ?? []; never fall back to the global list for an absent target.
sharedAPI.mapValidation: When present, require keys be valid IDs and a subset of editableMemberIDs; each list is duplicate-free and contains neither None nor Owner. Empty/partial maps are allowed and fail closed through the accessor. Do not require a per-member Guest option to belong to ordinary grantableRoles, because the operation semantics are intentionally separate.
sharedAPI.mutationValidation: Use this same accessor in changeRole validation; approval continues to use grantableRoles plus the exact native pending identity/requestID checks. Remove/decline/revoke behavior remains untouched.
sharedAPI.compatibility: Nil preserves existing Heart/other callers without changing their initializer call sites, native roles, participant policy or wire formats. An explicit empty map is restrictive, not equivalent to nil.

nativeAdapter.targetScope: Preserve the current active/non-self/non-Owner/Owner-or-Admin-target restrictions as the removable set. Derive editable members by excluding existing Guests. Preserve Guest removal in the separate removable set.
nativeAdapter.perMemberMap: Supply an explicit map (including empty for no editable members). For each editable current Reader, include Guest plus the actor's ordinary roles; other editable targets receive only ordinary roles. Existing UI filters out the current role exactly as before.
nativeAdapter.testableProductionBoundary: Move only the current pure capabilities-construction block into an internal nonisolated static function on AnyNativeSharingService called by readSnapshot after its original full native reads and consistency checks. It takes decoded current member/members/invitations and returns the actual capabilities. This allows a direct source-level role-matrix test of the production projection without HTTP/runtime injection, a new manager, a setter or an external API.
nativeAdapter.preserved: All request paths/bodies, decodeMember, account/session/lease/cancellation checks and current snapshot sequencing remain untouched. Native authorizes every mutation.

ui.edit: In the member change-role ForEach, replace access to global grantableRoles with rolesForMemberChange(member.id), preserving the existing filter excluding member.role.
ui.preserved: Keep all23 added identifiers, all original identifiers/labels/confirmation actions/privacy/state/lifecycle, approval's global grantableRoles, and removal's separate membership check.

validationPlan.sourceOnly: No test authoring or execution is authorized by this proposal. Existing whole file prefixes must remain exact when candidate work is authorized.
sharedCases: Omitted/nil map preserves existing Heart role-change validation.
Explicit per-member Guest permits Reader-to-Guest while ordinary approval Guest remains rejected.
A supplied empty map or missing target refuses changeRole even when the global list and editable ID would otherwise permit it.
A mapped but noneditable/foreign target cannot gain authority; malformed duplicate/None/Owner entries are refused.
Existing pending requestID matching, removal and Owner/self restrictions retain their behavior.
nativeCases: Call the actual extracted production projection over the independent Native contract matrix above.
Assert both Owner and Admin Reader-to-Guest options survive.
Assert Guest cannot be edited but its original authorized removal survives.
Assert Writer/Admin targets never receive Guest; Admin cannot alter Admin/grant Admin.
Assert ordinary approval roles contain no Guest/Owner/None, and self/inactive/nonmoderator restrictions survive.
validationPlan.targetImpact: Append focused tests to the existing two test files/targets; no new target/controller/fixture or accepted Native journey replay. NativeApplicationTests already imports the production Native module with @testable; test input/expected-role type inference can use the production helper's typed signature without a new shared import. Package/PBX changes are not planned. Actual compile/discovery/selection remains pending, not proved by source.

retainedBoundaries: Decline remains identity-only, with no caller expected-requestRecordId guarantee.
W1 consumed-request500 mapping successor remains their source/qualification scope.
No direct-add invitation, transfer ownership or guest-key route is invented.
Generic error/Refresh and lack of automatic resend are unchanged; full unknown-ACK retention/expected-effect readback/recipient convergence are not newly qualified.
Historical HTTP4's removed recipient is not a fresh pending request fixture.
No Native/API/account/host process/Mac/test/compiler/source/Git mutation was performed.
